name: Elasticsearch Connector
description: Provides an ElasticSearch backend for Search API.

suggests.drupal/key: API Key storage for connecting to Elastic Cloud.
suggests.drupal/search_api_autocomplete: Provides auto complete for search boxes.
suggests.drupal/search_api_spellcheck: Provides spell checking and 'Did You Mean?'.

provides_plugin_types: elasticsearch_connector (@ElasticSearchConnector, plugin.manager.elasticsearch_connector.connector) — Connector plugins in Plugin/ElasticSearch/Connector that build the Elastic PHP client (transport/auth) used by the 'elasticsearch' Search API backend; shipped: standard, basicauth, elastic_cloud_id, elastic_cloud_endpoint

elasticsearch_analyser (@ElasticSearchAnalyser, plugin.manager.elasticsearch_connector.analyser) — Analyser plugins in Plugin/ElasticSearch/Analyser for customizing Elasticsearch text-analysis settings at index-creation time; ships no concrete plugins in the main module (an example lives only in the test-fixture submodule)
